'''Bolts of Cloth''' are common crafting materials used in the creation of many types of caster armor.  It is typically found as salvage from existing cloth armor or dropped by enemies that wear clothes.

==Acquisition==
* Purchased from [[material trader]]s.
* [[Salvage Kit|Salvaged]] from:
** Armor crafted with Bolts of Cloth (see below).
** See [[:Category:Contains cloth]] for other items.
* For known [[creature]]s that [[drop]] Bolts of Cloth see [[:Category:Drops cloth]].
{{ongoing drop research}}
